Definition: Ebed, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ebed is the name of two Israelites, and both appear only in passing. The first is the father of Gaal, who stirred up Shechem against Abimelech in the days of the judges, and the second is the son of Jonathan who returned from exile with Ezra.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even these brief names matter, because God remembers the men history forgets. Their stories sit inside His larger work, whether in rebellion or in return.
RelatedPeople: Ebed, Father of Gaal; Ebed, Son of Jonathan; Gaal, Son of Ebed
